input: mkbp: Ensure button combos don't get read again on release When we to a VolUp+VolDown combo button press, we get the following button sequence from the EC (or equivalent, depending on what gets pressed and released first): 1. <none> 2. <VolUp> 3. <VolUp, VolDown> 4. <VolDown> 5. <none> Our current code generates two key codes from that: a VolUp+VolDown combo code from event 3, and a normal VolDown code from event 5, since it looks like a normal single button release. The second key code is undesired. This patch adds a new flag that makes the button sequencer wait until all buttons have been released after a combo before accepting new individual button presses. BRANCH=None BUG=None TEST=Boot Scarlet in recovery mode, press VolUp+VolDown, watch how it actually selects the Cancel option and doesn't randomly jump one up or down immediately. Change-Id: If7ec1812f5d6fd0718034781efbcae2622e01ffa Signed-off-by: Julius Werner <jwerner@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/884839 Reviewed-by: Furquan Shaikh <furquan@chromium.org>

Relanding 'update_engine: Add XZ compression for CrOS' This patch implements XZ compression for Chrome OS. It is only activated for only delta payload at this point. The XZ compression is typically slower than Bzip2 to compress, but faster to decompress. However, it uses slightly higher memory in decompression. It compresses about 5%-10% better than the current Bzip2.
